Ship Something Real, Then Learn From It

Building every planned feature before launch is the most expensive way to discover which ones users did not want.

We define the smallest version that delivers genuine value, ship it, and let real usage decide what gets built next.

The Store Review Is Part of the Project

App Store and Play Store rejections usually come down to the same handful of predictable issues: permissions, privacy disclosures, payment rules and metadata.

We design against those rules from the start and handle submission ourselves, so launch dates are not set by a surprise rejection.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Native or cross-platform?

Cross-platform suits most business apps and roughly halves the cost. Native is worth it for heavy graphics, deep hardware use or demanding performance.

How much does an app cost?

A focused first release typically starts in the low tens of thousands. Scope drives the number, so we cost it feature by feature.

Do you handle app store submission?

Yes, including store listings, screenshots, privacy disclosures and the review process itself.

Do we own the code?

Yes. The source code and the store accounts are yours, with nothing locked behind us.

Have an App Idea Worth Testing?

Tell us the problem it solves. We will scope the smallest version that proves it.
